dedupe_keys.name: gdv data service for the natural hazards report german insurers long term natural hazard loss statistics

description: The data service for the natural hazards report of the German Insurance Association brings together the long-term knowledge of German insurers about natural hazard losses and makes it available to anyone. Charts, tables and maps show losses from natural hazards to residential buildings, contents, motor vehicles, commercial, industrial and agricultural property, partly as long time series. Property insurance losses are broken down by federal state for storm and hail and for other natural perils such as flood and heavy rain, with insurance density, loss ratio, frequency and average loss; building losses are split by flood hazard class, and risk zone maps show where earthquake, lightning and overvoltage damage is most likely. The data service accompanies the 2025 natural hazards report and is also offered as a PDF of tables, data and graphics; it is free to use under the terms of use for data and graphics on the page. Caveats: figures are insured losses, so uninsured damage is missing, and a disclaimer explains the data. Coverage is Germany. It supports hazard exposure and economic analysis of natural hazard damage to buildings and assets, and calibration of loss models; it complements the GDV ZÜRS Geo flood zoning system catalogued by another piece.
